scope.note: 10.2.2.2 is a constraint-dense subclause: 27 of its 30 base units are numbered items already accounted by the numbered-rule inventory. The packet therefore newly accounts only 5 base units - 10.2.2.1 p1 and p2, and 10.2.2.2's unnumbered note, p1 and p2. No table falls in this scope.

authoring.author_context: fresh subagent context in an isolated worktree based on 05d6e08

independent_review.why_this_scope_is_high_risk: Pointer assignment is one of the most error-prone areas in the standard for a test suite, because the natural thing to observe - association status - is in several cases explicitly undefined, and reading an undefined status is not a conforming program at all.

accounting_verification.requirement_id_policy: Using R1034-R1041 and C1016-C1034 as structured requirement IDs matches suite_data enforcement and prior catalogues for numbered rules; no S identifier is minted for a numbered item.

zero_permissions_adjudication.claim: no unit in this scope grants processor latitude
zero_permissions_adjudication.method: Every unit scanned for 'may', 'can', 'need not', 'is permitted to' and 'processor dependent'. The terms 'may', 'need not', 'is permitted to' and 'processor dependent' do not occur in scope at all.

latitude_word_occurrences.text: Pointer assignment for a pointer component of a structure can also take place by execution of a derived-type intrinsic assignment statement (10.2.1.3).
latitude_word_occurrences.classification: effect / semantic route, not processor latitude
latitude_word_occurrences.reason: The sentence identifies another execution route by which pointer assignment occurs. It grants the processor no choice.

latitude_word_occurrences.text: A coarray can be of a derived type with pointer or allocatable subcomponents.
latitude_word_occurrences.classification: informative construct possibility, not processor latitude
latitude_word_occurrences.reason: Inside a NOTE, describing an admitted program shape.

under_claiming_review.10.2.2.2_p1: Correctly a definition: it states that data-pointer-object and proc-pointer-object denote the pointer object, and data-target and proc-target denote the pointer target. No shall, no independent obligation.
under_claiming_review.10.2.2.2_p2: Correctly a definition: it defines the pointer object and target for a derived-type intrinsic assignment. The effects remain with 10.2.2.1 and the later data and procedure pointer assignment subclauses.

attribution_table_audit.rule_applied: A facet may carry a diagnostic expectation only if the unit it is filed under actually prohibits something - an explicit shall, shall not, or a numbered constraint. Established in batch105.
attribution_table_audit.reviewer_method: Rows were checked against the pinned PDF rather than accepted. Every constraint yielding two or more negatives was examined to confirm each negative is individually attributable to one prohibiting clause rather than one program violating a constraint two ways.

pointer_specific_oracle_findings.undefined_association_status: No pending plan reads, compares, dereferences, invokes or inquires about a pointer whose association status is undefined. The catalogue explicitly forbids ASSOCIATED and any other inspection for undefined status - such a program would not be conforming.
pointer_specific_oracle_findings.associated_oracles: ASSOCIATED is proposed only after another cited source establishes defined status, with 16.9.20 retained as an explicit dependency, so no circular oracle is claimed.
pointer_specific_oracle_findings.bounds_shape_oracles: The source-only plans assert no LBOUND, UBOUND or SHAPE result. Where future lower-bound observation is mentioned, nondefault bounds and the LBOUND dependency are stated so the assertion cannot be vacuous.
pointer_specific_oracle_findings.coarray_volatile: C1023 is kept as a source constraint and requires no image execution; dependencies on 8.5.4, 8.5.6 and future image execution are explicit.
pointer_specific_oracle_findings.unspecified_values: No sentinel inequality or unspecified-value comparison is used.

ownership_findings.registered_neighbours: 10.2.1.1-10.2.1.5 are registered; the packet cites 10.2.1.3 for derived-type intrinsic assignment rather than duplicating it.
ownership_findings.parallel_sections: The packet explicitly leaves detailed data-pointer and procedure-pointer assignment effects to 10.2.2.3 and 10.2.2.4, which were authored in parallel as batch108, and claims nothing over 10.2.2.5.
unregistered_dependencies_flagged: Clause 15 procedure interfaces, characteristics, results and elemental rules

nonblocking_observations.observation: R-rule entries carry the required-diagnostic obligation but only positive syntax facets were authored. Accepted as established project convention, consistent with earlier R-rule catalogues.
